summary: Salt City Plumbing, Heating & Air (www.saltcityplumbing.com) shows Established digital maturity (score 72) with excellent reputation and SEO fundamentals, but measured mobile experience is Poor. Lighthouse mobile performance: 43/100; largest contentful paint: 10.0s and Time to Interactive displayValue: 28.7 s on WordPress. Homepage has heavy forms and incomplete alt text. Evidence supports prioritized performance, form, accessibility, and maintenance fixes without needing to rebuild search visibility.

topOpportunities.title: Fix mobile performance bottleneck (10.0s LCP, 28.7s interactive)
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse mobile performance: 43/100; largest contentful paint: 9996.393999999998 ms (10.0 s) ; Time to Interactive displayValue: 28.7 s ; Root document took 2,610 ms
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Measured Poor mobile performance increases friction before visitors reach booking CTAs, despite SEO 100/100 and claimed profile driving traffic.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Prioritize mobile speed triage first: reduce unused JavaScript (Est savings of 735 KiB) and unused CSS (Est savings of 118 KiB), address server response time, and defer non-critical scripts. Re-test mobile Lighthouse on https://www.saltcityplumbing.com/ after.

topOpportunities.title: Reduce initial form friction (25 inputs on homepage)
topOpportunities.evidence: Form field count on homepage: 25 and homepageSignals.forms: 2 and InputCount 25 on https://www.saltcityplumbing.com/
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: The first website form asks for many details at once — shorter initial capture can be tested to see if more mobile visitors complete the existing booking link.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Simplify the first form step to 3-5 required fields (name/phone/zip or issue type) and move 25-field detail to step 2 or post-submit. Keep 5 CTA phrases but test a single primary 'Request Service' above the fold.

topOpportunities.title: Complete image alt text and core accessibility fixes
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Many homepage images do not have useful alternative text and Lighthouse accessibility is 80/100 — improving alt coverage helps screen-reader users and supports the existing SEO 100/100.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Write descriptive alt text for the ~56% of homepage images missing it (27 images total). Fix flagged accessibility items: Elements use prohibited ARIA attributes, Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio, and Links do not have a discernible name.

topOpportunities.title: Fix 1 broken internal link (500 on /site-map)
topOpportunities.evidence: Broken internal links: 1 of 50 checked and brokenLinkDetails url: https://www.saltcityplumbing.com/site-map status: 500
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Single broken link among 37 internal links observed on homepage is low severity but easy maintenance win; prevents crawler and user dead-ends.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Fix or redirect the 500 at https://www.saltcityplumbing.com/site-map and re-check 50 internal links. Verify sitemapPageCount is null is intentional and that internal site-map references point to correct URL.
